title: Power to relax:

checks.requirement: Evaluate the package or inspection data against the legal requirement preserved in source_text.

source_text:
33. Power to relax:
The Central Government may, after ascertaining the genuineness of the compounding of
a case or Court decision stated in the application, permit a manufacturer or packer to pack
for sale the packages for a reasonable period by relaxing one or more provision of these
Rules with such corrective measures as may be specified.
